title: Princess Y85
highlights: Vector fin stabilisers with zero-speed mode
Cockpit servery and third control station
description:
A 2023 model-year Princess Y85 with only 260 engine hours (April 2026), lying in Singapore. Twin MAN V12-1900 engines are paired with a Sleipner vector fin stabiliser system working underway and at zero speed.

She features a bespoke saloon karaoke system, a cockpit servery, third-station controls, a GRP flybridge hardtop, a watermaker and underwater lights.
